Ứng dụng hỗ trợ khách hàng gửi yêu cầu l: The app helps customers request a designated driver, track ride status and communicate with drivers using the available features. Driver matching depends on the area, time and service availability.
Bạn cần cung cấp thông tin chính xác, gi: You must provide accurate information, keep your sign-in details secure and use only your own account. Update your profile when your information changes. Do not use the app for impersonation, harassment or unlawful activity.
Trước khi xác nhận, hãy kiểm tra điểm đó: Before confirming, check the pickup, destination, selected vehicle, scheduled time and notes. The app displays an estimated fare before submitting a request. Ride fares and statuses are updated in the app using ride data.
Hiện tại ứng dụng hỗ trợ thanh toán tiền: The app currently supports cash payments. Offer codes apply only when the conditions shown in the app are met.
Khả năng thay đổi hoặc hủy phụ thuộc vào: The ability to change or cancel depends on the ride status. Follow the options shown in the app. Any applicable fees or handling procedures follow the information applicable to the ride at the time of the action.

Không can thiệp, gây quá tải hoặc tìm cá: Do not interfere with, overload or attempt unauthorized access to the app or other accounts.
Dịch vụ có thể gián đoạn do kết nối, bảo: Service may be interrupted by connectivity, maintenance or a lack of suitable drivers. The app currently has no hotline or SOS feature and does not replace emergency response services.
Tài khoản có thể bị giới hạn khi phát hi: Accounts may be restricted if fraud, safety concerns or violations of the terms are detected. You can request account deletion from Profile. Some ride and transaction history may be retained under the service's procedures.
Điều khoản có thể được cập nhật khi dịch: These terms may change as the service evolves. The current version will be published on this screen. Please review it before continuing to use the relevant features.
Tài khoản và hồ sơ: số điện thoại đã xác: Account and profile: your verified phone number, full name, email, date of birth, gender and profile photo, if provided.
Thông tin chuyến: địa chỉ và tọa độ điểm: Ride information: pickup and destination addresses and coordinates, time, selected vehicle, notes, fare, payment method, status and ride history.
Nội dung bạn gửi: tin nhắn và hình ảnh t: Content you submit: messages and images in your profile, vehicles or conversations when you use those features.
Dữ liệu vận hành cần thiết cho đăng nhập: Operational data needed for sign-in and notifications, such as Firebase identifiers and device tokens.
Dữ liệu được dùng để xác thực tài khoản,: Data is used to authenticate accounts, create and coordinate rides, calculate routes and fares, display history, send notifications, troubleshoot issues and protect accounts. Ride addresses and coordinates are sent to map services for routing or geocoding when needed.
Thông tin cần thiết của chuyến được chia: Necessary ride information is shared with the matched driver to complete the ride. Administrative staff may access data needed to operate the service, resolve disputes and maintain safety.
Ứng dụng sử dụng nhà cung cấp kỹ thuật c: The app uses technical providers for authentication and notifications (Firebase), maps (Mapbox) and image storage (Cloudinary) when you use the corresponding features. Data may also be disclosed when required by law.
Trong luồng đặt chuyến hiện tại, bạn nhậ: In the current booking flow, you enter addresses and the app processes the corresponding coordinates to calculate routes. The app does not request background location tracking permission from customers. Profile, vehicle and chat images are selected only when you choose to upload them.
Dữ liệu được lưu trong thời gian cần thi: Data is retained as needed to provide the service and fulfill the purposes above. On account deletion, profile information is anonymized or deleted under the service's procedures. Ride and transaction history may be retained. App-managed images enter the corresponding deletion process.
Bạn có thể xem và cập nhật một số thông: You can view and update some information in Profile or request account deletion in the app. You also have rights under applicable personal data laws, including requesting access, correction, deletion or withdrawal of consent where applicable.
Ứng dụng áp dụng các biện pháp kỹ thuật: The app applies appropriate technical and operational measures to limit unauthorized access or use. This policy may change as features or regulations change. The current version is published on this screen.
